title: Define SGI feedback and remediation loops from implementation
requirements:
- Require structured feedback tied to artefact, version, system and use case
- Show bidirectional flows in the SGI figure: publication downward; implementation feedback, requests and quality issues upward
- Take in evidence that governed content is misread at the point of care
- Classify issues (content defect, implementation error, configuration, source data, training) with owners and deadlines
- Route issues to both artefact stewards and source-system owners, and make bidirectional governance explicit
- Define community participation rights and processes
